notes: Borderline, not failures: (1) syn-rec-00 (dev) gold_answer 'Hotel Aurora in Porto' but gold evidence is only t2 ('The Hotel Aurora'); 'Porto' comes from t0, so evidence is incomplete for the full answer. (2) syn-ins-21 'Did the auditor find any issues?' with 'Fine overall.' is labelled insufficient; arguably a reader could take 'fine overall' as no issues. A human reviewer (H2) should look at these. Also: the test for the review file runs on tmp copies, so a stale committed review-sample.md would not be caught by tests (it is currently identical). Synthetic scenarios are heavily templated and reuse the same first names across dev and test; this is not content leakage but gives low diversity. Dataset recall is only 10 per split, so most recall cases are single-fact synthetic ones.
